Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · dataset size: The dataset contains 45,199 question-image instances: 38,990 training, 1,705 public-test and 4,504 private-test instances.

candidate.next8.wsdm2023.paper.dataset-splits-and-overlap.v1

  • About 20% of the challenge bounding boxes had nonempty overlap with original COCO rectangles, and the authors placed all such instances in training.
  • The released CSV schema contains image URLs, English questions, image dimensions and bounding-box coordinates.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · evaluates: The evaluation averages intersection over union between each predicted answer box and its ground-truth box; each item IoU is the boxes intersection area divided by their union area.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · evaluates: A separate Toloka annotation round measured non-expert human performance without providing ground truth; the report gives mean IoU of 0.87 ± 0.01 across the three dataset subsets.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · human annotation: Toloka workers selected images containing objects they found interesting, composed questions about those objects and then marked the answering objects with bounding boxes to exclude unanswerable questions.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · paper method: The winning system used a Uni-Perceiver backbone, ViT-Adapter localization and DINO prediction head with an auxiliary loss and test-time augmentation; Table 3 reports its private-test reproduction score as 76.347 on the displayed IoU ×100 scale.

candidate.next8.wsdm2023.paper.winning-system-and-comparison.v2

  • On that same private-test display, the crowd baseline is 87.154 and the YOLOR-plus-CLIP baseline is 21.292.
  • Contestants were allowed to use models pretrained on MS COCO and other datasets.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

WSDM Cup 2023 Challenge on Visual Question Answering · paper method: The starter baseline uses YOLOR to propose candidate rectangles, applies CLIP to compare the question with each bounded image region and selects the highest-similarity candidate.
